_: Shared fixture for src/shared/sdk-policy.ts, ios SdkPolicy.swift, android SdkPolicy.kt and desktop sdk_policy.cpp (copies made by scripts/build-native-bundles.ts). links: checkLink(method, url) → the URL opened or null. haptics: checkHaptic(args). bridge: checkBridgeCall(method, args) → the action (or, for setResizeAnchor, the anchor the host keeps: {kind: "setResizeAnchor", edge}; for watchPublicData, whether the widget watches its shared public_data: {kind: "watchPublicData", on}) or null. hapticGate: steps on one HapticGate: decide(at, visible) → play | drop | report, or touch down / up: press(at) / release(at), the host's trusted presses. A touch (a finger down, then 5 s after it is lifted) lets haptics through under the rate limit; outside one the first call opens a series whose first second passes, the next series needs a touch or 10 s since the last began; a press with no release counts as lifted 30 s after it began. themeParams: checkThemeParams(input). locales: checkLocale(input). storage: checkStorageCommit(input) → the commit or null; strings in `repeat` are expanded (s repeated n times) before the check. utf8: utf8Length(s). The bot's data and requests: bridge has request ([id, data]: id 1–2147483647, data 1–64 UTF-8 bytes) and copyText ([text]: 1–256 UTF-16 code units). widgetData: checkWidgetData(input, copy) → {chatData, publicData, rejected}: each field text of 1–1024 UTF-8 bytes without a NUL or null, the empty string null, a broken field null and listed in rejected (chatData then publicData), a copy drops chatData without listing it. viewer: checkViewer(input) → {viewer, rejected}: the input and the viewer have the widget's field names (Mini Apps' WebAppUser: id, first_name, last_name, username, is_premium); no viewer (null) without an integer id of 1 to 2^53 − 1; a name is 1–64 UTF-16 code units, a username 5–32 characters of A–Z, a–z, 0–9 and _, is_premium kept only when true; a field that breaks its rule is left out and listed in rejected (first_name, last_name, username, is_premium); strings in `repeat` are expanded. chatType: checkChatType(input). answers: checkRequestAnswer(input) → {result} or null when result is over 1024 bytes or has a NUL (an absent result is null). requestGate: steps on one RequestGate, decide(at, {gesture, visible, canQuery, backgroundQuery}) → foreground | background | held | disabled | busy | no-activation | rate-limited, finish(), or show(at) → expect (the widget appeared on screen: its next background request may go out at once; true when the request held while it was off screen goes out now). requestRefusals: requestRefusal(verdict) → the error code or null. previewMethods: allowedInPreview(method) → whether a preview (an inline result not sent yet) may make that bridge call: only ready and setResizeAnchor (a preview never watches its public_data). Inputs here are typed as the native hosts take them (strings or null, integer ids). No lone surrogates here: they cannot cross every platform's string type unchanged.

hapticGate.name: a burst of 5, then one every 100 ms
the bucket refills to 5, not beyond
hidden: dropped without using the bucket, reported once per second
a clock that goes back refills nothing
the bug: a timer with no touch gets one second of haptics, then nothing for 9 s, then another second
a slider drag: haptics pass while the finger is down and 5 s after it is lifted, then one series
one series after a tap, even 10 s later; the next needs a touch or 10 s
a second series without a touch within 10 s is dropped
a press whose release never came counts as lifted 30 s after it began

storage.note: keys that name Object.prototype members are plain keys

widgetData.note: a copy never has chatData: dropped, not rejected
the empty string is how the bot clears a field
a NUL is not text (the server refuses it): like the other limits

viewer.note: no id, no viewer: the other fields do not matter
is_premium only when true, as in WebAppUser
a field that breaks its rule is left out, the viewer stays
names count UTF-16 code units: an emoji is 2
an empty name is not a name
rejected fields in this order: first_name, last_name, username, is_premium

answers.note: an empty answer: the request closes without a result
an empty result is a result

requestGate.name: a tap: one request in flight, the next tap after the answer
no tap and no backgroundQuery (a group, via bot, a live copy): refused
backgroundQuery: visible only, one per 5 s from the start of the last
no canQuery (sent without allow_queries, or a copy of one sent without fwd_allow_queries): never, with a tap or without
a tap on a hidden widget is no tap
a refused request leaves nothing in flight
busy before the background rules; a tap's request does not count toward the interval
the widget appears on screen: its next background request goes out at once, then one per 5 s
show changes nothing in flight, without canQuery or without backgroundQuery
a background request off screen is held (in flight) and goes out when the widget appears, as that appearance's; then one per 5 s from then
a held request goes out once: a second appearance with nothing held sends nothing, and only frees the next background request
finish drops a held request (the widget stopped): nothing goes out when it appears
nothing is held without backgroundQuery or canQuery: the hidden request is refused, and an appearance sends nothing
held after a visible background request: the interval does not apply off screen, the appearance sends it at once
